language_change_for_udhr: one that a translator can use: norm candidates can sit inside the document. All 81 candidates of the 33 reading sets, the u074 permission and the 16 single-reading units are now stated as content of the translation itself, and Lean checks every part: the premises verdict is 'model' for every compatible choice of every part, with CONFLICT-FREE among rules on the same act under every reading. No UNFORMALISED unit is upgraded: their blocks (act-phrase grammar, time, causation, attribution, rules, modality) did not move. The whole declaration still cannot be ONE checked document (see findings).
language_findings: NEW and usable: norm candidates as reading-set content beside norm-defaults@0 (RD-2b). Lean elaborates the filled document, Python's search found a separating situation for every ordered pair (no pair missing), Lean admitted every one, and a deliberately wrong situation is refused (rs_u111: 'distinguishing model does not separate readings')

LIMIT 1, size: an environment holds at most 64 regulated predicates; the declaration needs 91 (34 obligation, 28 permission, 29 plain). Stating the 29 entitlements as assertions over ordinary predicates (below) leaves 62, but the second limit still forces parts

LIMIT 2, independence: the enumerated route multiplies the candidate counts of independent sets (ReadingsNotSuperposable under the unspecified completion): 33 multi-reading sets give far over 64 choices ('over 64', UNKNOWN). Nine parts, each at most 64 choices, are checked; the whole declaration is not one checked document. RD-3 (the fold in Lean) is where this should move
LIMIT 3, time: elaboration grows faster than the predicate count (0.4 s for 10 regulated predicates, 80 to 100 s for 53) and a 53-predicate part exceeded the service's CPU deadline in check

FINDING, English layer: a pair whose separating probe is a 'plain' regulated predicate cannot be worded ('outcome wording needs a checked deontic value'), so ve document check answers CheckerUnavailable. Workaround, and arguably the more faithful form: an entitlement is stated as the assertion that a property holds of every case its guard picks out (mixed assertion/norm pairs fall back to wording E24)

FINDING, distinct wording: the English view requires every predicate to have its own wording (V4); nine prohibitions shared the act phrase '{0} take place' and two '{0} be carried out' across different sorts, so the merged vocabulary gives each its own act phrase (wording only)

FINDING, names: companions that reuse a base predicate or sort name with different meaning (is_arbitrary, is_slavery, concerns_*, measure) must be renamed when merged; the pilot does it mechanically (suffix with the unit id)

FINDING, display: the shown separating situation names one element of every sort and every filled gap of the part, not just the ones the pair depends on, so the English of a pair is long and mentions unrelated rights
limits unchanged and still blocking the 46 UNFORMALISED units: act-phrase grammar (11), time (5), causation (4), attribution (4), rules (7), comparison (2), modality/belief (2), and singletons
